biotools.summary: VMTK is a collection of libraries and tools for 3D reconstruction, geometric analysis, mesh generation, and surface data analysis for image-based modeling of blood vessels. This toolkit was utilized in a study analyzing factors contributing to airway navigation failure during R-EBUS.
